onboarding.heroSubtitle: This onboarding guide introduces our culture, expectations, and the resources that help you thrive.
onboarding.valuesDescription: These principles guide how we collaborate and serve our customers.

values.title: Integrity first
values.description: We act with honesty, keep our commitments, and own our decisions.

values.title: Empathy for people
values.description: We listen carefully to colleagues and customers to understand their needs.

values.title: Continuous improvement
values.description: We experiment, learn, and refine the way we work every day.

onboarding.conductDescription: Keep these rules in mind as you work with your team.

conduct.title: Respectful communication
conduct.description: Use inclusive language, be punctual, and keep discussions professional.

conduct.title: Protect confidential data
conduct.description: Never share customer or employee information outside authorized channels.

conduct.title: Ask for help early
conduct.description: Raise blockers quickly so we can solve them together.

onboarding.safetyDescription: Your wellbeing matters—let us know if something feels unsafe.

safety.title: Workspace ergonomics
safety.description: Adjust your workstation and take short breaks every hour.

safety.title: Security practices
safety.description: Lock your device when away and report suspicious activity immediately.

safety.title: Emergency procedures
safety.description: Follow the building evacuation plan and check in with your lead during drills.

nextSteps: Meet your mentor during the first week to review role expectations.
Complete required training courses listed in the Learning Portal.
Review project documentation in the shared drive.
Join the #welcome channel to introduce yourself to the team.
